title: Relay Race (taking turns)

links.title: LeetCode 1114: Print in Order (the same idea)

hints: Shared state: int turn = 0 (whose turn it is), a std::mutex and a std::condition_variable.
run: std::unique_lock lock(m); cv.wait(lock, [&] { return turn == id; });  Now it is your turn.
Simplest correct version: keep the lock while calling leg(), then turn = (turn + 1) % runners, unlock, notify.
Use notify_all(), not notify_one(): notify_one may wake a runner whose turn it is not; it goes back to sleep and the baton is lost forever.
With a single runner, (0 + 1) % 1 == 0: the turn comes straight back, nothing special to do.
